description: The Emberveil Sovereign — the person who went into the Rift thirty years ago and has been becoming something else ever since. Three variant configurations based on the party's accumulated choices.

variants.label: The Pact-Bound Sovereign
variants.description: Shrine purification, Pact-stone recovery, and Ancient Pact alignment have weakened the Sovereign's hold on the Rift boundary. The entity is diminished but still present. The parley option is viable.

phases.name: Thinning
phases.onEnter: The Sovereign's form flickers — the Pact-stones are pulling at the seams of what it has become.

phases.name: Recognition
phases.onEnter: The Sovereign pauses. Something in it recognizes the Pact-marks the party carries. Something old and not yet lost.

variants.label: The Unchecked Sovereign
variants.description: High world corruption, shrine destruction, and Ashen Veil alignment have strengthened the Sovereign's connection to the Rift. The entity is at peak power. The parley window is narrow. The fight is brutal.

phases.name: Full Extension
phases.onEnter: The Sovereign extends fully — the Rift boundary is not holding it back at all. This is what it looks like when there is no resistance.

phases.name: Sovereign's Will
phases.onEnter: It is speaking. The words do not parse as language. The intent parses perfectly.

phases.name: Last Offer
phases.onEnter: Something changes in the Sovereign's posture. It has made this offer before. It is making it again.

variants.label: The Returning Sovereign
variants.description: The Guardian was redeemed, the Pact-stone was recovered, and the party parleyed with the Herald. The Sovereign recognizes the pattern. It was a person once. It may be one again, differently. The ascension path opens.

phases.name: Memory Surface
phases.onEnter: The Sovereign's form stabilizes briefly into something recognizably human. The thirty years are visible on it.

phases.name: The Offer Reversed
phases.onEnter: The Sovereign stops attacking. It makes a gesture with both hands — the old compact gesture, the one from the Architect's Verge glyphs. It is asking a question.

variants.label: The Sovereign
variants.description: The Sovereign in its standard configuration — neither weakened by Pact-alignment nor strengthened by corruption. Difficult but not impossible. The fight is what it always would have been.

phases.name: Second Form
phases.onEnter: The Sovereign expands beyond its initial boundary. This is the shape it takes when it stops conserving.

phases.name: Final Declaration
phases.onEnter: Something in the Sovereign has decided. The fight, or the question — it has chosen.
